steps.content: The power of fear takes hold of Hella. With the girl's scream, it expands and actually splits into two identical monsters.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Argh... Let go of me! Let go!
The writhing colorful chaos is shattered, and it releases its grip on Hella. She falls from mid-air and is caught by you, just barely.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella, mind suppression. Control your fear. The monster you create from your fear is almost as big as EMP's.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I was just surprised and jumped a little. How can I have created such a big thing? Where did Witching Hour learn inflation?
No time for wordplay. The colorful pieces don't disappear but start to merge with each other. They soon return to their original forms, generating more phantom monsters.
After devouring Enfer, Sosia's interference with reality is significantly enhanced. Even the tiniest fear will be captured and turned into reality.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The Mania field has gone completely out of control. Anyone with fear will be completely dominated, and the monsters born from fear will add to Witching Hour's power, making us more afraid...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Say something I don't know! Isn't this a ******* snowslide?!
As you speak, shadows close in again, and Hella subconsciously grabs you. You try to steady her mind with the shackles but find yourself unable to use them.

You can still feel the cold touch of the shackles breaking, freezing your hands. And it feels like you can still see Enfer's hollow eyes on the empty pedestal. They pierce your mind like two nails, and you find it impossible to break free.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is the center of the Mania field, and the mutation is the strongest here. We must get out of here.
...Get out of the place that can break your mental defenses and get rid of its influence, or you will all become the feeder of fear.
